title: Sharp librsvg memory vulnerability
preconditions: glibc Linux for documented RCE conditions
runtime hardening including Node PIE status
notes: Global librsvg overrides need independent version evidence. Blocking VipsForeignLoadSvg mitigates SVG decoding; PIE mitigates RCE but does not establish library patch state. Unknown libc/PIE stays unknown.
scope_policy: One distinct exploit per repository; aliases and affected products share this scope.
research_notice: Source research for a planned checker; not an executable rule or assessment result.
